# bucket-order

Five buckets granted in the reverse of spend order. The first charge (120) must empty the
allowance (40), then the taste (30, expires in 72 h, so before the never-expiring referral), then
the referral credit (50). The second charge (50) must come from the older top-up, leaving the newer
one whole. Source: `docs/design/pricing-model.md`, "Order".
